   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 25, 2026 - Aug 6, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _elizareid_, Jul 31, 2026, 1/5: "Always freezes and no in-app support"
            2. _Mavis417_, Aug 6, 2026, 3/5: "I have been using Todoist and really like the product, but I ran into a critical bug that locked me out of my account. My original account was created via Sign in with Apple. When I tried to update my account email address, I accidentally typed in an incorrect email address that belongs to someone else. Todoist sent the verification email to that wrong third‑party address. Now I cannot log in with my original Apple account anymore. I also cannot log in using that wrong email since it is not mine. I have no way to complete the verification step and regain access to my Todoist data."
            3. _EstePerk_, Jul 3, 2026, 4/5: "I've enjoyed using Todoist. However, I think the recent update to the app has completely broken my widget? It wasn't updating to show my updated project, so I deleted the widget and put it back, and after putting it back the widget is entirely black. I'm on iOS 18.7.8, if it helps."
